description: Erection of a rear roof extension with two front roof windows to the flat.  Erection of a single storey outbuilding to be used as storage in the rear garden of the flat
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( [Ex/002], [Ex/003], [Ex/004], [Ex/005], [Ex/006], [Ex/007], [Pr/008], [Pr/009], [Pr/010], [Pr/011], [Pr/013], [Pr/014],  Received: 31/11/2019, [Pr/012], Received: 07/02/2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - Before work starts on the loft extension, samples of the tiles (plain clay tiles to match closely the colour and texture of the tiles used on the existing roof) to be used in the finish of the external surfaces shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  The roof tiles on the existing roof surfaces shall be carefully removed, stored and re-used when the roof slopes are re-clad. The materials to be used in the construction of the outbuilding shall be white render to match the exterior of the main building.

Condition : 4 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall be used for the purpose as a store or for any other purpose incidental to the residential use of the dwelling known as 4 Northumberland Gardens, and not as a self-contained dwelling nor as a business premises, nor shall any kitchen, bathroom, toilet or bedroom(s) be installed in the outbuilding without the permission of the Local Planning Authority obtained through the submission of a planning application.
